mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 45 degrees near Verona Area High School under a waxing gibbous moon. The air quality index is currently 53, and you can catch the space station tonight starting at 6:32 AM as it travels from the northwest near the high school toward the northeast near Home Depot, remaining low near the horizon.

City updates include new guidelines for the Senior Center meal programs, which now require advance ordering by Wednesday of the prior week for pick-up. Additionally, progress continues on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, with underground utility work now finished.
There is plenty to do in town. Yoga at Insight Wellness is held today, and you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia this evening. Looking ahead, live music at Bailey's Run starts tomorrow.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident from Thursday, October 15, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I. Fortunately, no injuries were reported, and officers are currently reviewing evidence regarding a possible collision with a traffic sign.
The flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
